topics.headline: Renewed Iran conflict spikes oil, threatening July CPI/HICP reversal
topics.summary: Both US CPI and Eurozone HICP fell in June, but a reignited US-Iran conflict has pushed Brent back above $79 and reversed June's pump-price relief, raising the odds that July's readings tick back up in both regions simultaneously.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic tights at 2.77%, FOMC decision looms
topics.summary: With spreads at 2.77% (vs 20-year average of ~4.9%) and near 25-year tights, a hawkish Fed dot plot and the July 28-29 FOMC meeting create modest widening risk, though near-term catalysts remain limited beyond seasonal Q4 patterns and creeping strain in adjacent credit markets like private credit and Asian IG.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF inflow streak fragile as Fed decision looms
topics.summary: Three weeks of net inflows nearly reversed by a late $465M outflow led by IBIT, with Bitcoin down 2.8% and the Wednesday Fed rate decision poised to determine whether the streak extends or breaks into a second consecutive outflow week.

topics.headline: VIX ticks up toward 18.6 as Fed, Iran risks converge
topics.summary: VIX has risen from ~16.6 to ~18.6 over the past week amid a hawkish Fed dot-plot, a resumed Iran conflict, and a July 29 FOMC decision, with strategists (Schwab, Edward Jones) flagging further upside risk from PCE data, Mag 7 earnings, and rising oil prices—though the 3-month trailing average remains elevated from February

topics.headline: Dedicated AI power deals keep flowing despite overbuild jitters
topics.summary: Chevron-Microsoft's 2.67GW "Kilby" gas plant and National Grid's $1.75B Joulent investment show the dedicated-generation trend intact, even as power stocks like Vistra and Constellation dip on overbuild concerns; base rate (~monthly major deals for 18+ months) still favors a new announcement within 30 days.
